description: A toothed bronze wheel, still greased and still turning easily. There is nothing left anywhere to fit it into.
lore: Twenty-eight gold, and worth it as a curiosity and nothing else. The hall it turned in went. The [[monsters/rune_lion|lion at the door]] did not, and [[characters/7a779de1|Wendell]] walked that road while the roof was still on and will give you the animal in detail and not one single thing about the room behind it.

The cogs came through too, and by the hundred, and looking at one tells you why. A toothed wheel is about as little as a made thing can be. You can hold the whole of it in your head at a glance, and hand it to somebody else in one sentence, and no two people out of two different centuries would describe it any differently. A hall full of machinery is not like that. So what survives of a building nobody can name is the parts of it that fit in a hand — still greased, still turning sweetly, geared to each other and to nothing at all.
gm_notes: Selection pressure on objects: simple, universally describable things outlast complicated ones, same reason a face outlasts a person. Never state the rule here — the cogs are the argument.
